name: iac-azure-agent
description: Plain-English Azure infrastructure in Bicep, with an approval-gated workflow. Milestone 5 of 6: repository setup, adaptive requirements discovery, architecture proposals for approval, modular Bicep written and validated (Bicep CLI, secret scan, Checkov), published to a branch and pull request, previewed with Azure what-if, deployed only after approval of that exact change set, and verified by reading the resources back. Per-project config, a persistent resumable workflow, and guards against direct Azure changes.
